title: Long-distance healing in Australia over the phone

tellings.quote: I've seen it too many times. I've seen it happen in Australia >> over the phone >> long distance.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says strange things happen around him, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he has seen healing happen at a distance. He says he has seen it many times, including once in Australia, over the phone. If true, it would mean someone could be healed without anyone being in the room with them.
